title: WebAssembly workload acceleration enforcement
objective: Generate an inspectable workload acceleration dashboard and fail heavy public workflows closed on unreviewed portable computation or missing trusted route telemetry

oracles: focused synthetic route receipts and the checked-in browser workload manifests

handoff.summary: Added a strict workload policy/schema, deterministic JSON and Markdown acceleration dashboards, and a receipt consumer that derives public-workflow status from the parity corpus, performance manifest, capability report, production-kernel coverage, and private evaluator telemetry. Heavy workflows fail closed on missing or stale identities, partial or contradictory instrumentation, unavailable kernels, unexpected portable computation, and user-output-only route claims. Focused fixtures cover all four route classes and adversarial receipt cases.
risks: The checked-in dashboard intentionally reports failed until release parity and per-engine performance receipts are placed under .artifacts/wasm-workload-receipts; capability availability alone is not accepted as execution evidence.

The new host test cannot enter a repository runner tier inside this narrow lane because test/node-test-manifest.cjs is a shared integration file. Consequently pnpm test:changed and pnpm test:portable stop at the manifest completeness test until integration adds the exact entry below.
next_steps: Add "test/wasm-workload-dashboard.cjs" to the unit array in test/node-test-manifest.cjs; portable inherits it automatically.

Add package scripts: wasm:workload-dashboard = node scripts/wasm-workload-dashboard.cjs --write; architecture:wasm-workloads = node scripts/wasm-workload-dashboard.cjs --verify-generated; wasm:workload-enforce = node scripts/wasm-workload-dashboard.cjs --check. Append pnpm run architecture:wasm-workloads to architecture:check.

In the release evidence job, write the release parity receipt and Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit performance receipts beneath .artifacts/wasm-workload-receipts, then run pnpm wasm:workload-enforce. Regenerate the checked-in dashboard only when reviewed input manifests or policy change, not from ephemeral receipt output.
After shared manifest wiring, rerun pnpm test:portable and change this contract from active to review with a fresh passing receipt.
